overall_goal: Pluck, wash, and add Thai basil leaves to the curry.

goals.description: Pluck basil leaves from the plant and gather them on the pot lid.
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly plucks leaves from the basil plant, inspects them, discards bad ones, and collects the good ones on the pot lid.

goals.description: Wash and drain the gathered basil leaves at the sink.
goals.rationale: The person takes the pot lid with the basil leaves to the sink, rinses them under running water, and drains the excess water.

goals.description: Transfer the washed basil leaves into the cooking pot.
goals.rationale: The person moves to the pot, scoops the washed leaves from the lid into the pot, and then discards any remnants from the lid into the sink.

goals.description: Pluck, wash, and add an additional batch of basil leaves to the pot.
goals.rationale: The person plucks more basil leaves, washes them at the sink, squeezes out the water, adds them to the pot, and picks up a fork to stir.
